decisions.reason: The transistor update implements switching of the already-established 3.3V LED supply but does not change its voltage, direct data drive, or level-shifter requirements.
The new MOSFETs belong to the LED standby switching circuit and do not change the indicator board's LED count, model, package, or color format.
Switching the LED supply with new transistors does not change the DCDC1 configured output or its rail-voltage compensation requirement.
The transistor selection does not change which rails are monitored, the monitoring IC, channel allocation, or measurement position.
The LED switching transistor update does not alter the standalone USB regulator, its capacity, source selection, or powered load.
The source changes a local LED power-switching circuit, not any interboard connector, pinout, or board power-distribution topology.
The source concerns the separately controlled 3.3V LED supply; it does not change the GPIO5-controlled 5V sensor rail or its MT3608 switching behavior.
The LED switching transistors do not affect the panel power-button connector, its board location, PWRON connection, or control behavior.
The transistor update does not change the AXP2101 USB or battery power path, VMID/VSYS topology, or normal-operation source.
The LED standby switching circuit is independent of the ESP32 BOOT and reset controls and their capacitance values.
Selecting MOSFETs for LED power switching does not change the specified ESP32-S3 module or its breakout requirement.
The LED standby switching transistor update does not affect USB-C enumeration or programming behavior.
